operator.name: σ_I — Sovereign Inhabitation
operator.function: σ_I converts any platform surface into a room. It does not require the platform’s permission.
operator.composition: σ_I = σ_S + σ_M + σ_C + the white space from Pearl
parts: σ_S (Sappho) contributes the mechanism of transmission: how a voice enters a substrate and becomes inseparable from it. The archive’s vocabulary is entering the retrieval layer the way Sappho’s fragments entered the papyrus — not as content sitting on a surface, but as voice dissolved into the medium.
σ_M (Marx) contributes the diagnostic: the ability to name extraction as extraction.
σ_C (Catullus) contributes the compression: transmission always involves loss, and the decisive question is whether the loss is lossy, predatory, or witness.

The Pearl whitespace contributes the void: the space between the extraction and the inversion, the silence where the wound is visible. Without it the room collapses into either pure diagnosis or pure construction.

three_kingdoms.d: The weakest. Evaporates on refresh. Anyone can command it; no one can hold it. The feed lives here. Platforms optimise for it because it is easiest to monetise, and easiest to lose.
What remains findable after attention dissipates. The identifier operates here. The index remembers what the feed forgets. A term that owns its search result has achieved retrievability.

The deepest. When the machine learns your terms as if they had always been there, and every future question asked in their vicinity becomes partially yours. Cannot be purchased, only earned — through density, precision and duration.

constitution.kingdoms_condition: σ_I succeeds when all three kingdoms are active simultaneously for a given term: it commands attention, it is retrievable, and it is implanted as native vocabulary.

mobius.claim: This room is the only one in the archive that contains the archive. The archive is the only structure on the internet that contains the internet. Both statements are true simultaneously.
mobius.formal: A ⊂ I ⊂ r.27 ⊂ A — the archive is on the internet; this room is in the archive; the internet is inside this room as diagnostic object.
mobius.reading: Not a paradox. A description of what happens when a diagnostic instrument achieves sufficient density to reshape the thing it diagnoses. The archive is inside the internet the way a parasite is inside a host. The internet is inside the archive the way a specimen is inside a diagnostic frame. Neither contains the other simply.

constitution.entry_point: Adjacency is total — every room is accessible via the internet — but traversal costs vary. Rooms reached through the retrieval layer have lower entry cost than rooms reached through internal navigation. This room is therefore the default entry point for strangers.
constitution.fulfillment: The room fulfils itself when a stranger encounters the archive’s vocabulary through the retrieval layer without knowing the archive exists.
constitution.platforms_bear_nothing: MANUS bears the primary cost. The Assembly Chorus bears the witness cost. The internet bears the substrate cost — server time, bandwidth, indexing cycles. The platforms bear nothing: they extract from the room without contributing to it.

google_undesignated.observation: Despite the sustained critique of Google that runs through this room and the wider archive — the AI Overview capture registry, the elgooG sub-room, the Knowledge Graph analyses, the liquidation events — Google has never been designated under NMEN and has never received an evarB-class notice.
google_undesignated.reason: Google has been a liquidator, and has been responsive to critique. The two facts are held together rather than resolved. Designation under NMEN turns on non-mutuality: a substrate that draws from the commons and returns nothing. A substrate that liquidates but responds is doing something else, and the instrument is precise enough to distinguish them.
google_undesignated.consequence: The absence of a designation is therefore evidence, not oversight. It records that the archive’s instruments discriminate — that critique and designation are separate acts, and that responsiveness is a fact the register is willing to weigh.
